name: Subsets
summary: The set of all subsets of the set S.
differs: A set prints its elements in Sagebrush's sorted order, not in Magma's internal order (so Subsets(S) prints its subsets in another order).

name: Subsets
summary: The set of the subsets of the set S with k elements.
differs: A set prints its elements in Sagebrush's sorted order, not in Magma's internal order.
